description: This file contains functions and logic for managing sandbox environments, including resolving scripts, checking Docker availability, handling sandbox images, and issuing scope warnings within the openclaw project.

classes.name: SandboxScriptInfo
classes.description: Type defining the structure with script path and current working directory for sandbox scripts.

methods.name: resolveSandboxScript
methods.description: Resolves the absolute path and working directory of a sandbox script based on a relative path.

methods.name: runSandboxScript
methods.description: Executes a sandbox script with a timeout, logs progress, and handles errors.

methods.name: isDockerAvailable
methods.description: Checks if Docker is available by running 'docker version'.

methods.name: dockerImageExists
methods.description: Checks if a specific Docker image exists locally.

methods.name: resolveSandboxDockerImage
methods.description: Resolves the Docker image to use for sandbox based on configuration or defaults.

methods.name: resolveSandboxBackend
methods.description: Determines the backend (default 'docker') for sandbox operations.

methods.name: resolveSandboxBrowserImage
methods.description: Resolves the browser image for sandbox from configuration or defaults.

methods.name: updateSandboxDockerImage
methods.description: Updates the sandbox Docker image in the configuration.

methods.name: updateSandboxBrowserImage
methods.description: Updates the sandbox browser image in the configuration.

methods.name: handleMissingSandboxImage
methods.description: Handles missing sandbox images by prompting for build and attempting to build if needed.

methods.name: maybeRepairSandboxImages
methods.description: Checks and repairs sandbox images and environment, including Docker availability and image existence.

methods.name: noteSandboxScopeWarnings
methods.description: Generates warnings for sandbox scope overrides that are ignored due to 'shared' scope.
